    France defeated Colombia 3-1 in a March 2026 international friendly, featuring rotated lineups from both sides. France’s lineup featured a young starting XI with goals from Désiré Doué (two) and strong defensive performances, while James Rodriguez and Luis Diaz led Colombia, with Jhon Arias scoring their goal. 
    France Lineup (vs Colombia - March 29, 2026) 
    • Goalkeeper: Brice Samba
    • Defenders: Pierre Kalulu, Maxence Lacroix, Lucas Hernandez, Lucas Digne
    • Midfielders: N'Golo Kanté (c), Warren Zaïre-Emery
    • Forwards: Désiré Doué, Rayan Cherki, Maghnes Akliouche, Marcus Thuram
    • Substitutes: Kylian Mbappé, Eduardo Camavinga, Randal Kolo Muani, Ousmane Dembélé, Hugo Ekitiké 
    Colombia Lineup (vs France - March 29, 2026) 
    • Goalkeeper: Alvaro Montero
    • Defenders: Daniel Munoz, Davinson Sanchez, Juan David Cabal, Johan Mojica
    • Midfielders: Richard Rios, Jefferson Lerma, James Rodriguez (c)
    • Forwards: Jhon Arias, Luis Suarez, Luis Diaz
    • Substitutes: Juan Fernando Quintero, Jamilton Campaz
